name: Osmania Biscuits
instructions: 1. Cream the butter and powdered sugar together until light and fluffy.
2. Sift the flour, milk powder, custard powder, and salt together.
3. Gently fold the dry ingredients into the creamed butter mixture.
4. Add a small amount of milk to form a soft, smooth dough; do not over-knead.
5. Shape the dough into small, thick discs.
6. Place the biscuits on a baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 15–20 minutes until golden brown.
7. Cool completely on a wire rack to achieve the desired crisp texture.
description: Named after the last Nizam of Hyderabad, Mir Osman Ali Khan, these biscuits are an iconic staple of Hyderabad's legendary Irani café culture. They are known for their signature melt-in-the-mouth texture and a unique subtle saltiness that complements the strong, sweet taste of Irani chai.
